newsitem.title: UK: New flights from Manchester airport detailed.
newsitem.headline: New flights from Manchester airport detailed.

text.p: The UK's Manchester airport said airlines will launch new services this year on routes to New York, Istanbul, Lisbon and Oporto.
Delta Air Lines will start a daily scheduled Lockheed Tristar service to New York's JFK from June 2, departing at 13.00, the airport said in a statement.
A three times a week Boeing 737-400 service by Turkish Airlines between Manchester and Istanbul will begin on June 15.
Portugalia Airlines starts its first service to the UK on March 15. A Fokker 100 will fly five times a week from Lisbon and Oporto to Manchester.

Earlier this year British Airways Express -- operated by Sun-Air of Scandinavia under a franchise agreement with BA --launched a twice daily service to Billund, Denmark, on January 20, the airport added.
